info.description:
Explore HollyHR’s organisation-scoped API for people, structure, working patterns, time off, document metadata, payroll exports and webhooks.

Start with **Inspect the authenticated API key context** for the quickest first 200 response. Set `baseUrl` to your workspace API URL and set `bearerToken` locally; this public collection never contains a credential.

Reads are available on every plan. Governed writes are included on Standard and Plus when a System Admin explicitly grants the required scopes. Use a disposable tenant while evaluating writes and preserve ETag and idempotency safeguards.
